source.title: Water Pouch Bounty
source.objective: ProgressBack again, <name>?  If you have five more Wastewander water pouches, then I have a care package with your name on it!
source.completion: Excellent - the more water pouches we are able to reclaim, the further away from disaster we'll all be!  Keep 'em coming, and I will be sure to reward you for every five water pouches you bring me.
